answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every new identity to lock a refundable bond before earning reputation. A beacon randomly assigns auditable jobs; if evidence links identities to one operator, those accounts forfeit their bonds. Honest agents recover the stake and earn fees, while an attacker must fund a separate bond for each fake identity and risk losing it. A willow withdrawal delay gives reviewers time to verify disputes, and an ivory ledger makes each forfeiture independently checkable.
